verdict.rationale: uv supports `uv python pin` which writes a checked-in `.python-version` file to pin the Python runtime per project, and this pin is respected by CI/other commands; project tool/dependency versions are also tracked in checked-in pyproject.toml/uv.lock and can be upgraded via `--upgrade-package` or `uv tool upgrade`. Missing for 10: evidence of non-Python runtime support (uv is Python-specific) and independent hands-on confirmation of the pin/switch workflow beyond docs.
